cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(test_project)

include(FetchContent)

# Test FetchContent_Declare with Git repository
FetchContent_Declare(
  json
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/nlohmann/json.git
  GIT_TAG        v3.11.2
)

# Test FetchContent_Declare with URL and hash
FetchContent_Declare(
  fmt
  URL https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/releases/download/9.1.0/fmt-9.1.0.zip
  URL_HASH SHA256=5dea48d1fcddc3ec571ce2058e13910a0d4a6bab4cc09a809d8b1dd1c88ae6f2
)

# Test FetchContent_Declare with GitLab
FetchContent_Declare(
  spdlog
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://gitlab.com/gabime/spdlog.git
  GIT_TAG        v1.11.0
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(json fmt spdlog)
